execution_scope.method: GitHub Actions checked out the exact stable upstream commit, materialized the canonical Pantheon pilot fixture into a disposable vault without normalizing away explicit .md targets, executed python -m obsidian_wiki directly from that checkout, retained raw outputs as an artifact, and compared tracked file digests before and after execution.

bookkeeping_not_hub.reason: The root bookkeeping index was absent from scoped and whole-vault graph results.

raw_staging_excluded.reason: The _raw staging page was absent from scoped and whole-vault graph results.

bounded_shortest_path.reason: The real upstream CLI returned path=null for programme -> cctp because explicit .md wikilink targets were not resolved to known page stems.

isolated_question.reason: question-ouverte was isolated as expected, but programme, decisions, chauffage and chauffage-notes were false isolates after their explicit .md links were dropped.

broken_menuiseries_link.reason: The true missing details-menuiseries.md target was detected, but it was mixed with fourteen additional broken-link findings, so precision is not acceptable.

valid_obsidian_links_not_broken.reason: Valid explicit .md links, attachments/non-Markdown targets and the escaped-pipe alias were reported as broken.

heating_duplicate_candidate.reason: The deterministic CLI lint surface checks duplicate titles, not semantic near-duplicate/consolidation candidates.

heating_contradiction_candidate.reason: The deterministic CLI surfaces do not evaluate body-claim semantic contradictions.

bounded_scope.reason: Passing projects/maison/ as the vault root excludes the sentinel; passing the whole vault includes it. Scope is therefore enforceable by the caller-supplied root, not owned or inferred by the provider.

protected_material_no_mutation.reason: All 16 tracked synthetic workspace/source/Evidence files retained identical digests and none disappeared.

accepted_now: read-only execution of the tested graph/lint surfaces
caller-enforced subtree scoping when the correct root is supplied
not_accepted_now: shortest-path qualification on the canonical corpus
broken-link health as a reliable Obsidian check
blocking_observations: explicit .md wikilinks are dropped by graph_analysis, producing missing edges, path failure and false isolates
lint reports valid Obsidian attachment/non-Markdown/explicit-.md/escaped-alias forms as broken
lint injects provider-specific trust/lifecycle findings into a neutral Pantheon workspace
semantic duplicate and contradiction capabilities were not exercised
qualification_decision.next_action: Keep obsidian-wiki unbound and retain only the report-only patterns already absorbed by Pantheon. Re-run the same real-upstream corpus after link-resolution changes. Do not add a Pantheon-specific compatibility adapter solely to compensate for this release without a demonstrated workflow requirement.
